_about: Read by: the Hitchcock Harness (the Takes view, the Shots page, Shot details), to put each shot of a pick-up under the place of its scene it stands for. Written by tools/film/land.py --stands-for when the pick-up lands; by hand only for what that cannot say.

Described in: Flow v3.3 - 8 Redos (step 14) and the app's edit recipe, "The film in shots". Goes to generations/FIX-<name>/FIX-<name>-stands.json, beside its takes/. Keep only the keys you need: inside, t0, t1, note and takes are optional.
